user_query: I'm starting a new business and would like to implement email marketing to reach potential customers. Can you provide me with the best email marketing services and programs? Additionally, I would like to analyze the nutritional data of the snacks I plan to offer in my office.

TaskList.description: Research and compile a list of the best email marketing services and programs.
Compare features, pricing, and user reviews of the shortlisted email marketing services.
required_inputs: list of email marketing services from step 1

TaskList.description: Select the most suitable email marketing service based on comparison.
Gather nutritional information of the snacks you plan to offer.
Analyze the nutritional data to determine health benefits and potential marketing points.
